notEstablished: The real receipt (R1) proves its bytes were signed by the pinned key. That this key lives in a genuine TDX enclave was checked live at capture (fixtures/nearai-receipt/attestation.json) and is not re-proven offline: that needs a fresh TDX quote + NVIDIA evidence bound to a new nonce (npm test with NEARAI_API_KEY).
With E2EE the signed request is ciphertext, so the plaintext prompt in the fixture is not covered by the signature.
TDX quote and NVIDIA evidence freshness: live-only (needs a fresh nonce from the gateway).
Injection detection is a pattern list; a cleverly worded name can pass it.
That the outbound review dialog sends nothing until Send is clicked is checked in the browser, not by this suite.
Session tokens live in memory only: by code inspection, not by a test.
